notes.title: 1.0 Is finally Ready
notes.content:
Version 1.0 is finally ready for launch on May 14th,

It is such an excellent feeling to be able to showcase our humble work to the world. We hope The Grandmaster will be loved by many and drives us to create even better games in the future.

[u][b]Features:[/b][/u]

[list]

[*]100 levels are good enough to entertain players for quite some time ( assume if you do not die a lot!)

[*]6 Challenges for Steam Achievements are ready to be taken.

[*]Infinite Mode - is total random madness for the Steam Leaderboard, no QA no Balancing, pure chaos.

[*]6 DLC will be available as soon as the game launches, it is purely cosmetical and has no impact in the game itself.


[u][b]Future Plans[/b][/u]

Available for MacOS and Linux
Support Controllers


-Yin Fei-
